title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words

meta.Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh wow...!
Ichika's become even better than before.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Her voice has so much more power and emotion behind it now, and it's so much fun to drum to it...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She did say that she worked on a song that we don't usually play for the Fan Festival, so could that be why...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Saki and Shiho look like they're having fun too.
 ...Alright, I'm not going to hold back!)
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whew...
Today's show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought so too...!
It felt incredible to sing throughout all that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The crowd's been warming up to us more too. They seem a lot more into our music now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I noticed that too!
I couldn't help but dance a little while I played when I saw some people really getting into a groove♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when you were doing that shuffle?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki was dancing?
Hehe. I wish I could've seen that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all seem much more comfortable on stage now too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you didn't miss a note, and Ichika, you sound a lot more confident in your singing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You too, Honami. Before, you seemed hesitant, but you're drumming with more power now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of you have been making some big strides.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho. That means a lot to us coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it really does...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we keep playing shows like this, do you think we'll be able to go pro?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things won't be that easy, but we'll keep improving as we practice and play in more shows. For now, we should just maintain the pace we've established.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We just need to keep putting everything into our practices and performances.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's pack up and head home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I need to talk to the manager about our next show. Also, I should ask about my shift schedule, so you guys can go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for everything.
You know, for helping us actually perform in shows like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask for any help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is really no big deal, so I can handle this on my own. If something does come up, I'll be sure to ask.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I should go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay, see you later...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Hona, where does this go again?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that goes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for today.
We really appreciate what you've been doing for us.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, Hinomori.
Leo/need's coming along pretty nicely, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll be looking forward to next month's show.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Likewise. I can't wait to see where you girls go as you keep getting better and better as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise not to let you down.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I do have a question about our shows... Mainly regarding ticket sales...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
You don't have anything to worry about since the owner and I like your band so much.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Don't let that get in the way of you guys performing in any shows, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
Again, we really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can't keep doing this forever, so starting with our next show, I'd like it if we could be treated like any other band when it comes to ticket sales.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
If you say so, Hinomori.
Shall we start discussing terms now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes please.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You too, Hona!
With more practice starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right.
We need to start working on our next song too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
I came up with a good melody, so I wanna have you guys hear it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You did?
I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I'll be looking forward to it, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I won't let you down!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm sure we're all tired after today's show, so don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! I know!
Shiho's gonna get mad at me again if I'm not careful♪
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye, Ichi, Hona!
See you tomorrow at school!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Bye. Get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bye bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika are working so hard between writing songs for us and practicing for our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's been handling all the paperwork for those shows, while working with us on an individual basis during practices...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not sure if there's anything extra I can do for us, but I want to help. I'll try thinking of something...
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was great!
You all sound so fired up today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that sounded very good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our show today went better than expected and it feels like all our hard work is finally starting to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we're practicing every day, and you're all starting to get used to performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's three times you praised us today, Shiho! I promise to keep doing my best♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I know we've come a long way, but at the same time, I know we still have a lot to work on and need to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our next performance to resonate more with everyone who comes to see us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! It'd be amazing if we could play our second original song at our next show too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mean the song Ichika was writing lyrics for after our first show? Didn't you say that you were still working on the melody for it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guess what...? Ta-daah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I came up with it after our show yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...? Way to go, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hold on, all of this in one day?
You didn't pull an all-nighter, did you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
H-Hey, I'm being careful!
Hona told me the same thing yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It started with me wondering how some of my ideas would sound, and before I knew it, I ended up with a whole pile of them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's incredible, Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I just wanted to turn what I was feeling into music! Kinda like what Ichi said during our last show, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that's the case, then your music should go really well with my lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I hope so too...!
Mind if we listen to what you have, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, go for it!
Here, let's start with my first one♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So, what do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think I like your first one.
It suits my lyrics the most, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I felt the same way. You could tell how excited Saki was about coming up with it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Do we have a consensus?
Why don't we run with it? I have a feeling it'll do pretty well if we play it live.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song's turning out to be another good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I can't wait to play it for everyone during our next show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But will we have enough time to practice before then...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
We need to learn our respective parts and put it all together during practice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We might not have enough time to polish it up for an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've been playing mostly the same songs during our shows, so it would be nice to introduce a new one during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, everyone...
How would you feel about me putting together the schedule leading up to our next show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember most of what we did after our first song was finished, including how we practiced playing it for that show, so I think I can put one together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! You're the best, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that would be a huge help.
Mind handling all that then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Just give me a little bit of time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we take a break while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go talk to Rin♪
She wanted me to recommend her some songs last time, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, wait. Where's Rin?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I haven't seen her today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did she run off somewhere?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin's showing our newcomer around right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Newcomer?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, guys, I'm back☆
Oh, Ichi and the gang are here too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome back, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that means this is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So you're the ones who created this SEKAI. Nice to meet you. I'm Kagamine Len!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: L-Len...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's me. I joined Miku's band a little while back, and I'm really glad to be here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You came here after me, so that means you're my junior now, right♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hold on, Rin, that doesn't make any sense...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure it does!
So call me, “Senpai,” okay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on that logic, that means KAITO's also Rin's junior, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin's junior...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're still like a big brother to me, KAITO☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This place just keeps getting livelier and livelier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, is it true that you've been playing in shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but we're still very new to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were just talking about playing a new song during our next one too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you mean the song Ichi was writing lyrics for? It's already done?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not quite. It still needs to be polished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We'd like to have it ready in time for our next show, so we're having Honami see if that's possible based on our current schedule.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your schedule, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's really admirable of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No... It's nothing, really...
I just wanted to find a way to help out everyone a little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A little...?
It's pretty big if you ask me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, Rin would never be able to handle anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?! Why me?! You couldn't handle it either, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, will you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, here's the schedule I've come up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's the verdict?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... Today, we'll practice like normal, and if we really work on this song for an hour each day, we could conceivably be ready in three-days time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which would leave making adjustments during practice. Our last one took around two weeks, so I suspect this one will take just as long...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's so specific!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd been playing everything by ear up until now, but having an actual schedule in front of us like this really tells us what we'll need to do by when...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
As long as we stick to this schedule...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Sorry, I have a meeting on Friday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll have to leave a little early whenever I have to go to work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll make those adjustments.
Just tell me about any other clashes if you think it's going to be an issue.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hona!
About this week...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I thought we'd be fine since our show isn't until next month, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: With all these clashes, it's going to be pretty tight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It'd be fine if we weren't working on a new song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Isn't there anything we can do about this?! I'll practice really hard on my own when I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate your concerns, but this schedule wouldn't mean anything if it becomes too unrealistic, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She's right...
There'd be no point in pushing ourselves too hard. We need to think about this based on what we have now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But...
Does that mean we have to give up on our new song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've come this far, so it'd be nice to give the crowd something new...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wanna give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shiho!
I promise to try extra super hard!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just not too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're so motivated now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We all want to see our new song become a reality and show everyone how fun it is to play music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Based on this schedule, it might be better for them to focus on practicing than selling tickets for our show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I'll just have to take care of that...
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The melody's pretty much done, but I feel like something's missing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I came up with this while thinking about how much fun it is to play in shows with you guys, but it still doesn't seem right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you think it's too bright and happy?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe it lacks depth...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Depth?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Overall, the song Saki's come up with here is really catchy and fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But the chorus feels a little thin because of how it lacks any deeper meaning if that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In my opinion, if you really want to get your message to hit home, you'll need to give the first two verses more substance.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do we have to rewrite it again...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we have a better idea of where we want our song to go now, so I'm sure we'll be okay as long as we keep chipping away at it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't have school today either, so we can focus on this for now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, sounds good.
Let's make it our goal to finish this before the end of the day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How's this for the first verse...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I like this! It sounds really cool!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it starts off strong too.
What if we make the second verse also sound a little more subdued by using more minor chords instead?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. So this part should be more like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll try singing this part.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Go for it, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How was that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Much better than before! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the chorus has so much more energy now. Wanna go with this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should be able to finish the whole thing if we keep this up. I know it won't be easy, but would it be okay if we kept going?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Finally...!!
We did it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we have to write everything for each instrument now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, I just wanted to express how happy I am about actually finishing the entire thing♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But this took much longer than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It did... Our first song only took about half a day to finish.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I was so sure that it'd be about the same for this song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were on a pretty good roll that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This time, we ended up spending a lot of time trying to mimic the melody from our first song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
This song does sound a lot like our first one. I might be biased towards this kind of music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's nothing we can do about that. You like what you like. No one's capable of doing everything, and it's actually pretty common to mirror music that you like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, you both put a lot into this song, so it would be nice to add more of a personal touch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may've taken longer than we expected, but I really like this song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I can't wait to play it together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we should start working on the music for each instrument.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Given that we start working on that today, it'll probably take... Two days?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll have to adjust the schedule again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yikes... Our practice schedule's really gonna be cutting it close, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe it isn't a good idea to get a new song ready for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I can't say for sure...
But we should keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll do everything I can to help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho.
I'll keep trying my best too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, but it is getting pretty late...
We should probably go home soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, something smells really good. Is it already time for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I think you're right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You should all stay and eat!
How about it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? No, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
Mom probably already made enough for all of us anyway!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lemme go ask! Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I really should head home...
There's something I need to check that involves work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I really wanted to have dinner with you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But work is work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
How about you two, Ichi, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... Haven't decided yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, if it's okay with your Mom, I'll call home to say that I won't need dinner tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do that too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks, you two♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, I really need to get going.
Great work today, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Bye, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for today!
Lemme walk you out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi! Hona!
There's more than enough for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki.
Your Mom's an amazing cook, so I'm pretty excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I can't wait to see what she made for us. In the meantime, we should finish cleaning up here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Oh, it's Shiho's sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, and I don't see mine...
I think she took it by accident.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She couldn't have gone far, so I'll try and find her.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I tried messaging her but...
I hope she's still around here somewhere.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, so next month's...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you very much.
Yes, so during my next shift...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Phew... Thank goodness.
That takes care of a few of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Oh, Honami, it's you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't mean to scare you like that. Were you on the phone with someone just now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, with someone from work.
What are you doing here, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
I think you took my sheet music by accident, Shiho.

rows.Line: (I'll have to pay for them myself...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Bands that make one person carry most of the load usually don't last very long.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we'd be asking too much of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Honami sent me a message...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She wants to talk to me before practice tomorrow... Probably about these tickets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I appreciate her concern. I really do... But this is what's best for us right now.)
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'm so nervous...
Shiho's not one to change her mind after she's made a decision about something.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What if we do end up fighting...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Admittedly, Rin and I fight a lot, but if I ever really need to tell her something, I do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you're trying to go pro, right? You have to work together, which also means you're not always going to agree on everything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll be fine.
You girls always find a way to get through to each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to tell her how I feel and find a solution that we can both agree on...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay. I just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
So what is it that you want to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About selling tickets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's no way she could've left things as they are based on what happened last time...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really don't want to force the issue but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry, but my mind's made up.
I'm going through with this and that's that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, you won't have time to practice our new song if you help. We can't move forward unless we get better at performing in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'd be fine if we weren't working on a new song, but that's not the case, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are doing everything in their power to get our new song ready for our next show, so I want us to be able to do it justice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand exactly how you feel, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're so far behind schedule...
While Ichika and Saki are hard at work on our new song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand how you selling these tickets is probably the most logical decision based on our current situation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If that's the case, then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I don't want to see you have to work so hard all on your own like this, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've never sold any tickets before, but you have to ask a whole bunch of people if they'd be interested in seeing Leo/need perform, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That can't be easy...
Both mentally and physically.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You may have more experience than us when it comes to this, Shiho, but you're still suffering just like the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I have to think you're suffering more than that because you're doing this on your own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I knew you'd say that, Shiho. You always do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if this becomes more than you can handle? What if you can't play at your best or even be in our show because of this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I promise to be careful...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Can't I help you with this?
Ichika and Saki might be busy, but I think I can at least lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't you still need to practice?
We don't have much time until our next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you on track to selling enough tickets, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not, if I'm going to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it's okay. I still have time until our next show. I'm sure I'll figure out something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Figure out something...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm the one who asked for this, so I have to take full responsibility for my actions.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if I have a lot of trouble dealing with it, I'll get through it. So please, Honami, just focus on practicing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this the right answer...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this how things are supposed to be? Making Shiho do all of this on her own like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want you to keep suffering like this on your own...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. What you're doing is probably what's best for our band right now...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I absolutely don't want you to carry this weight by yourself! It doesn't seem right at all!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I'm asking a lot right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I want you to understand.
We care about you, Shiho. All of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because you're our dear friend...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You'd be worried sick if you noticed that Saki or Ichika started pushing themselves too hard, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I would be as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I don't want to stand by and watch you do this to yourself...!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Bands that make one person carry most of the load usually don't last very long.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I understand that you have a lot on your plate right now, but if this keeps happening, nothing good is going to come out of it.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: It'll probably also start affecting your music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (With some extra effort on my part, the others can focus on practicing and getting our new song ready for our next show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm used to doing stuff like this on my own, so it seemed like the right answer for us and for Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shiho, I want to help.
I'm going to help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I want to be there for you.
I refuse to stand by and just watch you do this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are doing everything they can for our new song, so I want to find a way to help too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise to be ready to perform during our next show and also promise to help those two with our new song as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're all in this together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I honestly didn't expect you to go this far, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you can't tell Ichika or Saki about this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If they find out, I won't hear the end of it and we won't be able to sell these tickets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I understand. I won't tell them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't have much time until our next show. It won't be easy to sell enough tickets while getting our new song ready.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just this once, will you help me sell tickets?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...!
Later that night
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you...!
I'll bring the tickets over later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's my pleasure.
I promise to practice to make sure you get to see a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? You'll ask your friends...?
That'd be great! Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, sure... I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
That's a few more off our hands.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Dad said that he'd ask around too.
At this rate, Shiho and I should just barely make it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure she feels some sense of relief too...
After school the next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you sold three already?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did! I asked someone I know and told them about how I'm in a band with my childhood friends. They seemed really interested and decided to buy a few.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That leaves twelve.
It's a lot, but I think we can do it as long as we share the load...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Thanks, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me. All I did was make a few calls.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still can't believe that you sold fifteen out of thirty all on your own, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know a lot of musicians so I asked the ones who I thought would be most interested first.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about Shizuku and your family?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She'd treat it like some sort of idol concert, so that's sort of a last resort...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Also, I'm really sorry.
I can tell that you'd rather tell Ichika and Saki about this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I would and it does bother me a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's better than letting you go through this on your own.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This time, it'll be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But starting next time, let's do this all together, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. I'll make sure things go smoother then.
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially considering how much effort we put into our new song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It wasn't easy, but I'm glad we made it in time for this show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right? Sometimes it felt like we'd never finish...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You would've finished eventually.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you all did a great job getting it done...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice work, Ichika, Saki.
You too, Honami. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything...
I should be the one thanking you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, the usual?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Take it away, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's make sure our new song reaches and moves everyone who came to see us today...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Okay, this is good...
Each verse has more depth to it and Ichika's making that clear through her singing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's synth is really shining right before the chorus too. Honami was right about holding back on the drums there.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And that's followed up by Honami's drum fill...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Perfect...
Ichika hit that high note right in time with that fill.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
This song's pretty good.
It's like it was made to cheer people up, you know?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, they've really upped their game too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The crowd seems to like it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And no mistakes as far as I can tell. They're playing like they really mean it. All that practice is really paying off...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was awesome!
And so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It really was...!
Everyone in the audience really seemed to like it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Seemed?
They did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of the work you put into it really paid off in the end. I'm sure they feel the same way too. Nice work, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's time for an after party!
I mean, after a quick debrief!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought you didn't like doing those.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our show went super duper well today, including our new song, so I'm too excited not to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right now, I want to keep improving and give everyone better performances, so let's do a debrief before I forget that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, before we do... When is our next show supposed to be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing's set in stone yet, but next month at the earliest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll have to practice quite a bit, again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's true, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Starting next time, I'm thinking about having us sell tickets for our shows. Would that be okay with all of you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tickets?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we'd be gathering people to come see our show and selling tickets to them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Until now, the owner and manager have been giving us a free pass, but if we're serious about going pro, this is something we'll have to do eventually.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Finding ways to sell tickets alongside practicing won't be easy, but we can take it one step at a time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I've never done anything like this before, but I think we'll be fine as long as we work together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you're right. We can do this as long as we're together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try calculating how much time we'll need to sell them and work that into our schedule.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad we got to talk about it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, you were right.
It's too much for one person to handle.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, my guess is that you'd do whatever it takes if we do ever find ourselves in a bind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: N-No, I wouldn't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Just a joke.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But if that ever happens...
Please, ask me for help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...
